ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.

3. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe from? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe from.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe from.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe from.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe from.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dangers of heat? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dangers of heat.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dangers of heat.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Dangers of heat.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dangers of heat.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Heat and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Heat and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Heat and its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Heat and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Heat and its resources.

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of heat in? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of heat in.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of heat in.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of heat in.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of heat in.

9. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Animals and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Energy: Heat and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of heat in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Dangers of heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
